adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly makes `destinationCalendar` an array on `CalendarEvent`, and `handleNewBooking.ts` now appends team member destination calendars for COLLECTIVE (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking it only connects the first destination calendar (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so the booking row retains only a single `booking.destinationCalendar`. Downstream flows shown in the diff (e.g., `confirm.handler.ts`, Stripe/PayPal webhooks, bookingReminder/webhook handlers) rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` solely from `booking.destinationCalendar` (wrapped as a single-element array) or the user’s destination calendar, meaning they cannot recreate the full team destination calendar list. As a result, any calendar-event creation that happens later (requires-confirmation confirmation flow, payment webhooks) will only target the first calendar and will miss member calendars.
